selection: Existing 0,+/-1,+/-2,+/-3 projected native horizontal-grid spacings retained for audit; numerical convenience, not population-based selection
profile_interpolation: Four-finite-corner native bilinear samples spaced at one quarter of projected native grid spacing; no extrapolation/smoothing. Width crossings linearly interpolated inside finite adjacent samples.
interpretation: One axis reference plus six unweighted central-region sensitivity starts; no whole-plume weighting, capture efficiency or total plume momentum flux inferred.
